method: Roll calls: House votes parsed from the House Chamber Voting System pages (https://www.house.mn.gov/votes/Details?BillNumber=...&SessionKey=300|302|304; SessionKey 300=2023-24, 302=2025-26 regular, 304=2025 1st Special Session), which list affirmative/negative members by surname label; each House roll call was cross-checked against the revisor.mn.gov bill-status vote tally and journal page. Senate votes parsed from official Senate Journal PDFs (mnsenate.gov/journals/<biennium>/<file>.pdf, located via the journal page number on the revisor bill page and https://www.mnsenate.gov/api/journal/gotopage). Every roll call's Y and N name lists were verified to equal the official yea/nay tallies. Surname labels (e.g. 'Lee, F.', 'Anderson, P. H.', 'Spk. Demuth') resolved to persons using the Legislative Reference Library roster of all members serving in the 93rd/94th Legislatures (https://www.lrl.mn.gov/legdb/results?search=session&gender=all&sess=94,93&body=both); 'Lee, K.' = Rep. Liz Lee and 'Anderson, P. E.' = Rep. Patricia (Patti) Anderson by elimination against the roster; House 2023 label "O'Neill" = Rep. Marion (O'Neill) Rarick. All labels resolved uniquely. Vote codes: Y, N, NV (on that year's LRL chamber roster but not recorded as voting: absent/excused, or not seated on that date - e.g., members who left or joined mid-year; the House voting system and Senate journal record only yeas and nays). A missing key = not a member of that chamber that year. Procedural votes (motions to suspend rules / take from table / recall) are included where the substantive bill never got a floor vote; read each desc for what Yes means. Candidates matched to LRL roster by surname + first name/initial (manually checked; Jr./II suffixes handled). incumbent=true means the candidate holds this same chamber+district in 2025-26 (district lines unchanged since 2022). Group lists fetched 2026-10-27/28, matched to ballot candidates by district + surname; see each list's note. LegiScan/Ballotpedia not used.
